campaigns_v2.notes: A/B test: Video lead form vs existing image lead form campaigns. Broader SoCal targeting vs SFV-only. Compare CPL, lead quality, and form completion rate.

budget_allocation_rationale.variation_a_wedding_30pct: Highest intent and highest ticket value. Wedding couples book early, have budgets, and are in peak decision mode for spring/summer 2026. This audience also converts well on Facebook/Instagram due to visual-heavy platform match.
budget_allocation_rationale.variation_b_corporate_20pct: Reliable repeat business potential. Corporate event planners rebook seasonally. Lower emotional urgency than weddings but strong LTV.
budget_allocation_rationale.variation_c_festival_party_20pct: Broad audience, high volume. Spring/summer party season drives demand. Good for brand awareness and lead volume.
budget_allocation_rationale.variation_d_construction_film_15pct: Niche but high-value. LA's film industry is a steady source of multi-day bookings. Lower competition for this audience on Facebook ads.
budget_allocation_rationale.variation_e_testimonial_15pct: Social proof converts fence-sitters. Retargeting-friendly. Works as a trust builder for people who saw other ads but didn't convert.

recommended_schedule.day_1_2: Launch all 5 ads. Monitor impressions, CTR, and CPM.
recommended_schedule.day_3: Pause any ad with CTR below 0.8%. Reallocate budget to top 2 performers.
recommended_schedule.day_4_5: Let top performers run. Check cost per lead.
recommended_schedule.day_6_7: Final optimization. Kill underperformers, push budget to lowest cost-per-lead ad. Document results for next campaign cycle.

creative_assets.recommended_per_ad: 2-3 images per ad (carousel or single image with A/B test)
